example:
import { EditorialStats } from "@godxjp/ui/layout";

<EditorialStats aria-label="Collection totals" items={[{ label: "Items in your collection", value: "12", unit: "items", note: "A collection of things you love." }, { label: "Single cards", value: "9", unit: "items" }, { label: "Sealed products", value: "3", unit: "items" }]} />
name: EditorialStats

props.name: items
props.type: { label: ReactNode; value: ReactNode; unit?: ReactNode; note?: ReactNode }[]

tagline: A strip of figure tiles on unequal tracks (gh#1439, default `1.4fr 1fr 1fr`): label, large tabular figure with a small unit, optional note. The first tile is the lead (quiet ground; a theme can span it across a phone row with its figure beside the label). Geometry: `--editorial-stats-*`.
usage: DO format the figures with Intl before passing them.
